name: RM-718

lead: RM-718 is an experimental weekly-dosed drug that activates the MC4R pathway of appetite regulation. Fat-loss followers watch it as a possible route to appetite control and a leaner physique.

As an MC4R agonist, it targets the pathway that lowers hunger signalling, the chain being reduced appetite, lower intake, then lower body weight and fat. A phase 1/2 study of 111 participants, including healthy volunteers and people with hypothalamic obesity or Prader-Willi syndrome, began in March 2024. No results or cosmetic data have been published.

paras: It is used only within the clinical study, designed for weekly dosing. No consumer routine exists.
Not approved, and no published safety results were located. The only available source is the trial registration.

trials.title: A Study of RM-718 in Healthy Subjects and Patients With MC4R Pathway Impairment

angle.text: RM-718 is a weekly MC4R agonist that acts on the brain's appetite pathway, so hunger signalling drops and body weight and fat follow. It is in early trials for rare obesity syndromes.

lead: RM-718 is an investigational melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) agonist developed by Rhythm, described as a weekly-dosed compound. [1] A phase 1/2 study of RM-718 in healthy subjects and in patients with MC4R pathway impairment, including hypothalamic obesity and Prader-Willi syndrome, began in March 2024 with 111 participants. [1]
It is not approved. No published results were located, and the only source is the trial registration.
